deadline.value: Applications complete by January 15 get full consideration for funded Fall admission; review continues on a rolling basis through May 15.
deadline.quote: To guarantee full consideration for Fall semester admission with funding, applications should be complete by Jan. 15 (although applications will continue to be considered on a rolling basis through May 15).

gre_general.value: The GRE General is no longer required for chemistry applicants but can still be submitted.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) general exam is no longer a requirement for application to the chemistry graduate degree programs. | However, students may still submit GRE scores as an option.

gre_subject.value: The chemistry GRE subject exam is not required.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE chemistry subject exam also is not required.

toefl_min.value: Chemistry requires a TOEFL iBT of 80.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum scores for graduate students who plan to study chemistry are TOEFL of 80 (IBT) or IELTS of 6.5 across all bands of the IELTS.

ielts_min.value: Chemistry requires IELTS 6.5 across all bands.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum scores for graduate students who plan to study chemistry are TOEFL of 80 (IBT) or IELTS of 6.5 across all bands of the IELTS.

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to identify research areas and contact faculty before applying.
supervisor.quote: Prior to applying, we encourage you to identify your research areas of interest. | You may also want to contact Faculty members working in your favorite research areas for more information.

funding.value: Full-year financial support, including a tuition waiver, is available for all PhD students.
funding.quote: Full-year financial support (including a tuition waiver) is available for all Ph.D. graduate students.

entry_route.value: The entry requirement is a bachelor's degree awarded before the program starts.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s degree awarded before the start date of the graduate program.
